Dealerships are the prefered repair facility for their ability to handle most repairs and warranties. If repairs are excessive in cost, please defer repair decisions to the Director of Technology. Each vehicle should have a spare tire somewhere on the vehicle, including the tools needed to replace the faulty tire with the spare. If you are unable to change the tire, call a tow service or roadside assistance. In the event that there is not a full size spare tire, make special note to not exceed the maximum rated speed of the smaller spare tire. This information will be written on the sidewall of the tire itself. NOTE: these spare tires are NOT off-road worthy. Be extremely cautious when operating in off- road conditions.
